scripts.build: npm run install-labextension && npm run build-ts
scripts.build-nbv6: npm run install-nbextension; npm run enable-nbextension && npm run build-ts
scripts.install-labextension: cd src/snp_jupyter && npm run build && cd ../.. && npm run uninstall-labextension; cp -r src/snp_jupyter/labextension $(ruby -e 'print(`jupyter lab path`[/Application directory:\s*(.*)/, 1].sub(/\/lab$/, ""))')/labextensions/snp_jupyter
scripts.install-nbextension: jupyter nbextension install src/nbextension_snp --debug --overwrite --user # will install to /Users/USERNAME/Library/Jupyter/nbextensions/
